prompt: Our open-source ETL pipeline project (dataflow-org/etl-pipeline) has been accumulating pull requests faster than the team can review them. We need a comprehensive triage report saved to a file called `triage_report.md`. The report should cover ALL open pull requests (not just recent ones), flag any that look like they're solving the same problem as another PR, score each PR's overall readiness, highlight anything that hasn't seen activity in a very long time, and surface the top 5 best candidates for merging. Use a duplicate-detection sensitivity of 75 (out of 100).
